en.titre:
10/10 outdoor hobbies that
actually work if you have adhd

en.accroche: you _fall in_ the second you _stop paying attention_
colonne: balancing on water needs your whole body, and the calm lake does the rest for a _noisy brain_
en.chute: rent one for an hour on a calm morning

colonne: running side by side keeps you going, and training for the same race gives you both a _finish line_
_pro tip_: i use atala, an ai running coach that plans my week around my goal
en.chute: pick a 5k and sign up together

en.accroche: the disc is _always moving_, so _you are too_
colonne: fast passes and quick turns keep your attention on the game, and a team keeps you _coming back_
en.chute: most cities have a casual pickup game

en.accroche: look at a painting, then _find the scene_ outside
colonne: a painting of a street at night makes you notice the real light on your walk home
_pro tip_: i use artura, one artwork a day with its story, zooming into the details you'd miss
en.chute: pick one painting a week and go look for it

colonne: you watch the water, wait and react, and that small chance keeps your attention _right there_
en.chute: most places sell a day permit, ask at the shop
